message.falsity.bonded: Falsity blinks up at you. It does not look away.
message.falsity.not_yours: Falsity tilts its head at you, then turns back to its owner.
message.falsity.sit: Falsity sits down and watches you.
message.falsity.follow: Falsity stands up and pads after you.
message.falsity.no_companion: Falsity is not nearby. It cannot hear you.
message.falsity.unavailable: Falsity is not listening right now.
message.falsity.talking_disabled: Falsity is not in a talking mood.
message.falsity.too_long: That is too long. Falsity's ears are small.
command.falsity.failed: Falsity could not be placed here.
